_xp_note: xp_to_next[L] = experience needed to go from level L to L+1 (index 0 unused).
_kill_xp_note: Same-level kill XP = base + per_level * mob_level; scaled by level difference (grey mobs give 0).
_level_up_note: Added to the character every level. 'hp' and 'resource' raise the base pools directly.
